verses.text: I go give you thanks with my whole heart. Before di gods I go sing praises to you.
I go bow down toward your holy temple and give thanks to your name for your faithful love and your truth, because you don exalt your word above all your name.
For di day wey I call, you answer me. You make me bold with strength for my soul.
All di kings of di earth go give you thanks, Lord, because dem don hear di words of your mouth.
Yes, dem go sing about di ways of di Lord, because di glory of di Lord great.
Though di Lord dey high, yet e dey regard di lowly, but di proud e dey know from far.
Though I waka for di middle of trouble, you go revive me. You go stretch out your hand against di anger of my enemies, and your right hand go save me.
Di Lord go fulfill im purpose for me. Your faithful love, Lord, dey forever. No forsake di works of your hands.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Lord, you don search me and know me.
You know when I sit down and when I rise up. You understand my thoughts from far.
You search out my path and my lying down, and you know all my ways.
Even before word dey for my tongue, look, Lord, you know am completely.
You hem me in behind and before, and you lay your hand on me.
Dis knowledge too wonderful for me. E high. I no fit reach am.
Where I go go from your Spirit? Or where I go run from your presence?
If I go up into heaven, you dey dere. If I make my bed for Sheol, look, you dey dere.
If I take di wings of di morning and dwell for di uttermost parts of di sea,
even dere your hand go lead me, and your right hand go hold me.
If I talk say, “Surely di darkness go hide me, and di light round me go be night,”
even di darkness no dey dark to you, but di night shine like di day. Di darkness dey like di light to you.
Because you form my inward parts. You knit me together for my mama womb.
I go give thanks to you, because I dey fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works dey wonderful, and my soul know am very well.
My frame no hide from you, when I dey made for secret and woven together for di depths of di earth.
Your eyes see my body wey never form. For your book dem write all di days wey dem ordain for me, before even one of dem dey.
How precious your thoughts dey to me, God! How vast di sum of dem dey!
If I count dem, dem plenty pass di sand. When I wake up, I still dey with you.
Oh God, make you kill di wicked! Depart from me, una bloodthirsty men,
wey speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name for vain.
Lord, I no hate dem wey hate you? I no dey grieved with dem wey rise up against you?
I hate dem with perfect hatred. Dem don become my enemies.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me and know my anxious thoughts.
See if any wicked way dey inside me, and lead me for di everlasting way.

chapters.title: For di Chief Musician. A Psalm by David.

verses.text: Deliver me, Lord, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men,
wey plan evil things for dem heart. Dem dey stir up wars continually.
Dem don sharpen dem tongues like serpent. Poison of adders dey under dem lips. Selah.
Keep me, Lord, from di hands of di wicked. Preserve me from violent men wey don plan to trip my feet.
Di proud don hide snare for me, and cords. Dem don spread net by di path. Dem don set traps for me. Selah.
I talk to di Lord say, “You be my God.” Hear di voice of my supplications, Lord.
Lord, di Lord, di strength of my salvation, you don cover my head for di day of battle.
No grant di desires of di wicked, Lord. No further dem evil plans, or dem go dey proud. Selah.
As for di head of dem wey surround me, make di mischief of dem own lips cover dem.
Make burning coals fall on dem. Make dem dey thrown into fire, into deep pits, so dat dem no go rise again.
Make slanderer no dey established for di earth. Make evil hunt di violent man to overthrow am.
I know say di Lord go maintain di cause of di afflicted and di justice for di needy.
Surely di righteous go give thanks to your name. Di upright go dwell for your presence.
Lord, I call on you. Hurry to me. Hear my voice when I call to you.
Make my prayer dey set before you as incense, di lifting up of my hands as di evening sacrifice.
Set watch, Lord, over my mouth. Keep di door of my lips.
No make my heart turn to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men wey dey work iniquity. No make me eat of dem delicacies.
Make di righteous strike me. E go be kindness. Make am rebuke me. E go be oil for di head. Make my head no refuse am, because my prayer dey continually against dem wickedness.
Dem judges don dey thrown down by di sides of di rock. Dem go hear my words, because dem dey sweet.
As when person plow and break up di earth, so dem bones don scatter at di mouth of Sheol.
But my eyes dey on you, God, di Lord. I take refuge for you. No leave my soul defenseless.
Keep me from di snare wey dem don lay for me, and from di traps of di workers of iniquity.
Make di wicked fall into dem own nets, while I pass by safe.

chapters.title: A contemplation by David, when e dey inside di cave. A prayer.

verses.text: I cry with my voice to di Lord. With my voice I make supplication to di Lord.
I pour out my complaint before am. I tell am my trouble.
When my spirit dey overwhelmed inside me, you know my path. For di way wey I dey waka, dem don hide snare for me.
Look to my right hand and see, because nobody dey wey care for me. Refuge don fail me. Nobody care for my soul.
I cry to you, Lord. I talk say, “You be my refuge, my portion for di land of di living.”
Listen to my cry, because I dey brought very low. Deliver me from my persecutors, because dem dey too strong for me.
Bring my soul out of prison, so dat I go give thanks to your name. Di righteous go surround me, because you go deal bountifully with me.
Hear my prayer, Lord. Listen to my supplications. For your faithfulness answer me, and for your righteousness.
No enter judgment with your servant, because for your sight no living person go dey righteous.
Because di enemy don pursue my soul. E don crush my life to di ground. E don make me dwell for dark places, like dem wey don dey dead for long.
So my spirit dey overwhelmed inside me. My heart dey desolate inside me.
I remember di days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I consider di work of your hands.
I spread out my hands to you. My soul dey thirst for you, like dry land. Selah.
Answer me quick, Lord. My spirit dey fail. No hide your face from me, or I go be like dem wey go down into di pit.
Cause me to hear your faithful love for morning, because I trust for you. Cause me to know di way wey I go waka, because I lift up my soul to you.
Deliver me, Lord, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.
Teach me to do your will, because you be my God. Make your good Spirit lead me into level ground.
Revive me, Lord, for your name sake. For your righteousness bring my soul out of trouble.
For your faithful love, cut off my enemies and destroy all dem wey afflict my soul, because I be your servant.
Blessed be di Lord, my rock, wey train my hands for war and my fingers for battle,
my faithful love and my fortress, my high tower and my deliverer, my shield, di one wey I take refuge for, wey subdue my people under me.
Lord, wetin be man, say you take notice of am? Or di son of man, say you consider am?
Man dey like breath. Im days na like shadow wey dey pass.
Bow your heavens, Lord, and come down. Touch di mountains, and dem go smoke.
Flash lightning and scatter dem. Send out your arrows and confuse dem.
Reach down your hand from above. Rescue me and deliver me out of many waters, from di hand of foreigners,
wey dem mouth speak lies, and dem right hand na right hand of falsehood.
I go sing new song to you, God. On harp of ten strings I go sing praises to you,
wey give victory to kings, wey rescue David im servant from deadly sword.
Rescue me and deliver me from di hand of foreigners, wey dem mouth speak lies, and dem right hand na right hand of falsehood.
Make our sons be like plants wey grow well for dem youth, and our daughters like pillars wey dem carve for palace.
Make our barns dey full, wey supply all kinds of food. Make our sheep multiply by thousands and by tens of thousands for our fields.
Make our oxen dey loaded. Make no breach dey, and no going out, and no cry of distress for our streets.
Blessed na di people wey dey like dis. Blessed na di people wey di Lord na dem God.
I go exalt you, my God, di King. I go bless your name forever and ever.
Every day I go bless you. I go praise your name forever and ever.
Great na di Lord, and e suppose get plenty praise. Im greatness no fit search out.
One generation go commend your works to another and go declare your mighty acts.
For di glorious splendor of your majesty, and for your wondrous works, I go meditate.
Men go speak of di might of your awesome acts. I go declare your greatness.
Dem go pour out di fame of your great goodness and go sing of your righteousness.
Di Lord dey gracious and merciful, slow to anger and of great faithful love.
Di Lord dey good to all, and im tender mercies dey over all im works.
All your works go give thanks to you, Lord. Your holy ones go bless you.
Dem go speak of di glory of your kingdom and talk of your power,
to make known to di pikin dem of men im mighty acts and di glory of di majesty of im kingdom.
Your kingdom na everlasting kingdom. Your dominion dey through all generations.
Di Lord dey uphold all dem wey fall and raise up all dem wey bow down.
Di eyes of all dey look to you, and you give dem dem food for di right time.
You open your hand and satisfy di desire of every living thing.
Di Lord dey righteous for all im ways and kind for all im works.
Di Lord dey near to all dem wey call on am, to all wey call on am for truth.
E go fulfill di desire of dem wey fear am. E go also hear dem cry and save dem.
Di Lord dey preserve all dem wey love am, but all di wicked e go destroy.
My mouth go speak di praise of di Lord. Make all flesh bless im holy name forever and ever.
Praise di Lord. Praise di Lord, my soul.
I go praise di Lord while I dey alive. I go sing praises to my God as long as I still dey.
No put your trust for princes, for son of man, wey no get help.
Im breath go go, e go return to im earth. For dat very day im thoughts perish.
Blessed na di one wey di God of Jacob na im help, wey im hope dey for di Lord im God,
wey make heaven and earth, di sea and all wey dey inside dem, wey keep truth forever,
wey execute justice for di oppressed, wey give food to di hungry. Di Lord set prisoners free.
Di Lord open di eyes of di blind. Di Lord raise dem wey bow down. Di Lord love di righteous.
Di Lord watch over di strangers. E uphold di orphan and di widow, but di way of di wicked e turn upside down.
Di Lord go reign forever, your God, Zion, to all generations. Praise di Lord.
Praise di Lord, because e good to sing praises to our God, because e dey pleasant and praise dey fit.
Di Lord dey build up Jerusalem. E dey gather together di outcasts of Israel.
E dey heal di broken hearted and bind up dem wounds.
E dey count di number of di stars. E dey call dem all by dem names.
Great na our Lord and mighty for power. Im understanding no get measure.
Di Lord dey uphold di humble. E dey bring di wicked down to di ground.
Sing to di Lord with thanksgiving. Sing praises on di harp to our God,
wey cover di sky with clouds, wey prepare rain for di earth, wey make grass grow on di mountains.
E dey give to di animals dem food, and to di young ravens wey cry.
E no delight for di strength of di horse. E no take pleasure for di legs of man.
Di Lord take pleasure for dem wey fear am, for dem wey hope for im faithful love.
Praise di Lord, Jerusalem. Praise your God, Zion.
Because e don strengthen di bars of your gates. E don bless your pikin dem inside you.
E make peace for your borders. E fill you with di finest of di wheat.
E send out im command to di earth. Im word run very fast.
E give snow like wool. E scatter frost like ashes.
E throw out im hail like crumbs. Who fit stand before im cold?
E send out im word and melt dem. E make im wind blow, and di waters flow.
E declare im word to Jacob, im statutes and im ordinances to Israel.
E no do so to any other nation. As for im ordinances, dem no know dem. Praise di Lord.
